long_biography.plain_text:
Born in 1955, Söderberg studied economics at the Stockholm School of Economics and earned an MBA from INSEAD. He then developed an operating career outside the ancestral holding company, becoming group chief executive of plumbing distributor Dahl. He later joined Ratos's board and rose to chairman, assuming an active role in the investment business descended from his family's steel-trading enterprise.

In parallel, Söderberg started Söderberg & Partners with Gustaf Rentzhog in 2004. The group grew around wealth management, non-life insurance and employee benefits, giving him a self-created financial-services interest alongside the inherited Ratos platform. He remains chairman of both businesses and founded Inkludera, while also serving as deputy chairman of the Stockholm School of Economics. His wealth therefore reflects inherited family ownership expanded through operating leadership, entrepreneurship and long-term investment stewardship.
